'''Faro''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Faro system/Legends|Faro system]] within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Imperial Corrections Officer]] [[Armitage]].
